proposedArgs.description: Research iCloud Drive sync visibility tools
proposedArgs.prompt:
Research and find the best methods to see which files iCloud Drive is syncing vs holding locally on macOS. Specifically:

1. How to use `brctl` command to inspect iCloud Drive sync status, file states (local/evicted/downloading), and get sizes of cloud-only files
2. How `find` with extended attributes (`xattr`) can detect iCloud placeholder files (files with `com.apple.icloud.itemName` or `.icloud` extension)
3. How to get total cloud-only (offloaded/evicted) size from iCloud Drive via CLI
4. Any third-party tools like iStatistica, DaisyDisk, or similar that show true iCloud Drive cloud usage
5. How to use `ls -l@` or `GetFileInfo` to see if a file is local or cloud-only on macOS

Search the web for accurate, up-to-date info on macOS iCloud Drive file states and CLI inspection. Return concrete commands and methods.

proposedArgs.command:
ICLOUD=~/Library/Mobile\ Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs

echo "=== CLOUD-ONLY (dataless) files ==="
find "$ICLOUD" -flags +dataless -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f "%z %N" 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -30

echo ""
echo "=== Total cloud-only apparent size ==="
find "$ICLOUD" -flags +dataless -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f "%z" 2>/dev/null | awk '{sum+=$1} END {printf "%.2f GB\n", sum/1024/1024/1024}'

echo ""
echo "=== LOCAL files (not dataless) ==="
find "$ICLOUD" -type f -not -flags +dataless -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f "%z %N" 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -20

echo "=== All Mobile Documents containers (cloud-only) ==="
find ~/Library/Mobile\ Documents -flags +dataless -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f "%z" 2>/dev/null | awk '{sum+=$1} END {printf "Total cloud-only all containers: %.2f GB\n", sum/1024/1024/1024}'

echo ""
echo "=== Per-container cloud-only sizes ==="
for d in ~/Library/Mobile\ Documents/*/; do
  size=$(find "$d" -flags +dataless -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f%z 2>/dev/null | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}')
  if [ "${size:-0}" -gt 1048576 ]; then
    printf "%.1f MB  %s\n" "$(echo "$size / 1048576" | bc -l)" "$d"
  fi
done 2>/dev/null | sort -rn

echo ""
echo "=== CloudDocs subfolders total size (local + cloud-only) ==="
for d in ~/Library/Mobile\ Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/*/; do
  local_s=$(find "$d" -type f -not -flags +dataless -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f%z 2>/dev/null | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}')
  cloud_s=$(find "$d" -flags +dataless -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f%z 2>/dev/null | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}')
  total=$((local_s + cloud_s))
  if [ "$total" -gt 524288 ]; then
    printf "%8.1f MB total (%5.1f MB cloud-only)  %s\n" "$(echo "$total/1048576" | bc -l)" "$(echo "$cloud_s/1048576" | bc -l)" "$d"
  fi
done 2>/dev/null | sort -rn

    tell process "Photos"

                click deleteBtn
                return "Deleted all WhatsApp items"
            on error e
                return "Dialog not found: " & e
            end try
        end try
    end tell
